name: Email Triage — Intelligent Alert System
description: Monitors Gmail continuously. Classifies emails using Claude API. Urgent emails (USCIS, job offers, banking) are delivered instantly to Telegram. Promotional emails are silently filtered. Reduces inbox noise by ~80%.

nodes.name: Gmail Trigger
nodes.description: Polls Gmail every 5 minutes for new emails

nodes.name: Classify with Claude API
nodes.description: Sends email subject + sender to Claude API for urgency classification

parameters.note: Replace YOUR_CLAUDE_API_KEY with your Anthropic API key

nodes.name: Is Urgent?
nodes.description: Routes urgent emails to Telegram alert, drops the rest

nodes.name: Send Telegram Alert
nodes.description: Sends formatted urgent email alert to Telegram

note: This is a documented workflow structure. Full JSON export available on request. API keys and credentials are not included.
